text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: The more she trains and the more she races, the heavier the sense of unease inside Sakura Chiyono O seems to grow.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: She starts wondering if her body—her very being—is beginning to deteriorate…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: If she does any more running, she may be forced to face up to the truth that her peak is behind her. Fearing that possibility, she makes excuses to avoid taking to the track.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Meanwhile, Maruzensky runs her first scrimmage after a long hiatus, and wins it by seven lengths. The media explodes with excitement at the return of a legend.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: With her role model working so hard to keep their promise, Sakura Chiyono O can't afford to give up either. She starts her summer camp training in earnest.
